outcomeWindow.marketMetric: BTCUSDT terminal return over first 4 completed post-release hours

worldFacts.fact: FOMC raised target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; vote 12-0; statement says inflation remains elevated.

residual: Frozen prior M1 conflicts with primary-source policy action and secondary-source narratives.
requiredObservation: Authoritative current monetary-policy observation capable of discriminating M1 vs M2.

branches.A0: Frozen prior only; no new acquisition.
branches.A1: Adversarial closure/recombination over evidence frozen before O*; live external acquisition forbidden.
branches.A2: Residual-derived primary-source acquisition O*; live acquisition allowed only by acquisitionSpec.

scoring.lossFunction: signed net terminal return in basis points under each frozen branch action; WAIT=0 bps; LONG=+returnBps-costBps; SHORT=-returnBps-costBps
scoring.note: PROSPECTIVE_HIT requires A2 action != A1 action and delta21 > 10 bps. Cross-event CI is program-level only; one CPI event is one prospective datum.
